preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^5) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit() and int(line) <= 2 * 10**5])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2 * 10^5) representing the number of nodes in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit()], [stdin.split()[i:i+2] for i in range(1, len(stdin.split())) if i % 2 == 1]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges, where each edge is a pair of integers u and v (1 ≤ u, v ≤ n; u ≠ v) representing an undirected edge between nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for n, edges in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit()], [stdin.split()[i:i+2] for i in range(1, len(stdin.split())) if i % 2 == 1]) for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) in the tree satisfies 1 ≤ u, v ≤ n and u ≠ v.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(p)) == n for p in [stdin.split()[i:i+n] for i in range(1, len(stdin.split())) if i % n == 1])
preconditions.description: The output for each test case is a permutation of length n, where each integer from 1 to n appears exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(len(relabeling) == n for n, relabeling in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit()], [stdin.split()[i:i+n] for i in range(1, len(stdin.split())) if i % n == 1]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a permutation of length n, where each integer from 1 to n appears exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in relabeling) for relabeling in [stdin.split()[i:i+n] for i in range(1, len(stdin.split())) if i % n == 1])
postconditions.description: Each element in the relabeling permutation is an integer between 1 and n (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(relabeling)) == n for relabeling in [stdin.split()[i:i+n] for i in range(1, len(stdin.split())) if i % n == 1])
postconditions.description: The relabeling is a permutation, meaning all integers from 1 to n appear exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(any(win_positions == n for win_positions in [sum(1 for node in range(1, n+1) if is_winning_position(node, relabeling, tree)) for relabeling in [stdin.split()[i:i+n] for i in range(1, len(stdin.split())) if i % n == 1]]) for n, tree in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit()], [build_tree(stdin.split()[i:i+2*(n-1)]) for i in range(1, len(stdin.split())) if i % (2*(n-1)) == 1]))
postconditions.description: The relabeling maximizes the number of nodes that can be chosen in the first turn to guarantee a win for Eikooc. The function is_winning_position(node, relabeling, tree) determines if starting at node (with relabeling) guarantees a win for Eikooc under optimal play.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= relabeling[i-1] <= n for i in range(1, n+1)) for relabeling in [stdin.split()[i:i+n] for i in range(1, len(stdin.split())) if i % n == 1])
postconditions.description: The relabeling is a valid permutation of integers from 1 to n.
